title: Casper and the Vector
author: J. M. Thackeray
blurb: Isandro Sandoval, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
